reviewer: Codex independent RLASM reviewer /root/teaching_prairie_review; separate from builder
scope: Fresh holistic source-locked architectural-clay review of all three unchanged source extracts, source board, all fourteen complete full-resolution GLB-reimport renders and both 1080x1920 phone boards. Checked source compatibility, massing/ratios, roof topology, every elevation, program, palette, apertures/optics, room depth, supports/load paths, contacts, circulation, landscape interface, visibility, cameras and all previous defects. No previous category pass substituted for current inspection.

findings.finding: The physical rectangular front art-glass border leads simplify the fine upper gridwork in source casements and sidelights. The main window cadence, openings and room depth remain intact. This is acceptable within the declared classroom architectural-clay scope, without detailed/textured-keeper fidelity.
findings.follow_up: Retain the fine-leadwork simplification in limitations. Further source-specific leadwork is optional bounded polish.

findings.finding: evidence/layout-provenance.json retains the phrase four original source-board panels in its operation description, although its exact hash keys/regions, actual board, prework and authoritative source-provenance.json consistently contain only the three enrolled compatible roles. This stale count does not change the enrolled bytes or disguise a fourth source.
findings.follow_up: Correct the stale operation-count sentence in a separate clearly identified metadata correction if this wording is reused; preserve this reviewed evidence and hashes.

source_lock_review.rejected_views: Original mirrored rear quadrant and additional chimney-drift rear proposal are explicitly excluded with exact hashes/reasons; source pixels were not repainted to follow the model.
source_lock_review.inferred_views: Rear, left elevation, metric scale and hidden rooms are declared architectural inferences. Their grammar/completeness were reviewed, with no exact unseen-source or historical-fidelity claim.

regression_review.proof: Fresh front.png ridge-to-front-eave rise is approximately135px over1248px width, about0.108, versus source approximately80/748, about0.107. Main wall/window datums and single-hip top plan remain intact. Roof reads as a distinct broad hip in front, sides, aerial and phone comparison.
Fresh source board and unchanged compatible extracts govern identity. Both contradictory rear proposals remain rejected; no exact rear match is asserted.
Fresh top.png retains the chimney near the source rear eave at about0.095 roof depth inward. Its support continues to grade and remains clear of the rear door/windows.
Fresh rear, rear-side and living views contain no sill belt crossing the garden-door aperture.
Updated chimney close shows seated cap and plane-following flashing; complete elevations, aerial and top retain neutral safety margins to highest terminations and full footprint.

whole_set_observations.rear: Inferred rear openings and clear garden door avoid the supported chimney; belts stop outside doorway.
whole_set_observations.rear_side: Full rear/side grammar, ground contact, coherent roof and positive chimney support.

whole_set_observations.glass_close: Actual optical layer, physical border leads and separately offset room/furniture depth are visible.

whole_set_observations.living_programme: Enclosed and visibly occupied residential depth, with hidden plan disclosed as inference.

limitations: Architectural-clay visual pass only, exact parent prairie_school_house and variant roman_brick_hip_roof; not keeper_approved or fully textured-keeper approval.
